raw_segments.text: Blazes Boylan presented to the leaders sky blue frontlets and high action a sky blue
tie, a wide brimmed straw hat at a rakish angle, and a suit of indigo surge.
His hands in his jacket pockets forgot to salute, but he offered to the three ladies
the bold admiration of his eyes and the red flower between his lips.
As they drove along Nassau Street, his excellency drew the attention of his bowing consort to
the program of music, which was being discoursed in College Park.
Unseen brazen highland, laddies blared and drum-thumped after the cordage.
